records.name: Karve
records.tagline: The API client for developers on Windows
records.description: Karve is a native Windows API client built around plain http files. Cold start under 2 seconds. Organize requests from every repo in one workspace, switchenv environments, keep searchable history. Files stay on disk, Git-friendly. No account. Buy once.

records.name: Dashi Metrics
records.tagline: Visualize your revenue on a 3D globe
records.description: Watch your business come alive—every visitor and payment mapped in real time on a dynamic 3D globe. Dashi transforms static dashboards into live, geographic visualizations, making global trends and customer activity instantly engaging. Spin, zoom, and interact with your data as it happens. Perfect for SaaS teams and founders who want actionable, visual insights instead of boring charts.

records.name: space ocr
records.tagline: OCR that checks its own answers, as an app or an API
records.description: space ocr turns photos of receipts, invoices and forms into a table you can query. Drop them into a folder in the app or send them to the API, and each page becomes a row you can filter and sort. Every value shows where it came from. 100 free pages a month.

records.name: Screen Awesome
records.tagline: The free screen recorder that cannot upload your video
records.description: Every screen recorder promises not to misuse your recordings. Screen Awesome can't: it requests zero host permissions, so Chrome itself blocks it from reaching any server. Check it in chrome://extensions before you install. Record a tab, screen or camera to MP4. Auto-zoom glides a virtual camera to every click. Screenshot a region or a full scrolling page. Annotate with arrows, blur, redaction, step counters and text — all editable vectors. Free, unlocked, no account, no watermark.

records.name: Crodo AI
records.tagline: Your voice-first AI assistant for macOS
records.description: Crodo is a voice-first AI assistant built for macOS. Dictate in any app, ask questions about what’s on your screen, chat with AI, capture meeting notes, and work with Gmail, Calendar, and Slack and may other apps coming soon, without constantly switching between tools. Crodo brings voice, context, and actions together in one fast desktop assistant.

records.name: Tixio 3.0
records.tagline: Start meetings from chat
records.description: Your team shouldn't need five tabs to plan work and talk about it. Tixio 3.0 lets you start meetings straight from Chat — no new tool, no tab switching. Discuss projects alongside built-in sprint reports and time tracking, so nothing gets lost between apps. We don't replace your stack. We take the best of each and bundle tasks, chat, docs & meetings into one workspace. $2.30/seat/mo · 14-day free trial · No card needed.

records.name: Glasp MCP Connector
records.tagline: Search your highlights and notes inside Claude and ChatGPT
records.description: Connect Glasp to Claude and ChatGPT as an MCP server. Search your highlights and memories in natural language, right inside your AI assistant. Read-only and private to you.

records.name: ScrollToll
records.tagline: Counts every Reel you watch, then locks the app.
records.description: ScrollToll counts every short video you watch — Reels, Shorts, TikTok — and hard-blocks the feed when you hit your daily limit. Minutes are abstract; a video count isn't. To keep scrolling you have to finish a guided breathing exercise first. Android.

records.name: MOTHER
records.tagline: A terminal built for Claude Code w/ one-click session resume
records.description: A native macOS terminal built around Claude Code. Project launcher, one-click session resume, and a menu-bar alert when Claude needs you. $9.99.

records.name: Snipplet
records.tagline: Create and share beautiful guides from places you love
records.description: Most travel tools help you plan trips. Snipplet does the opposite. It's for places you've already been and actually loved. Save your favorite spots, add photos and tips, and it becomes a visual guide you can share with one link. No more scattered screenshots or 47 tab Google Docs. Make it yours with custom fonts, colors, stickers, backgrounds, and themes. Or drop a screenshot in and let AI build it for you. Real recs from real people. Works for Tokyo or your favorite spots around the corner.

records.name: Vinyl for Mac
records.tagline: Turn your Mac into a spinning vinyl player.
records.description: Vinyl turns your Mac desktop into a beautifully animated record player. It syncs with Spotify and spins every album you're listening to in real time. It quietly lives in the background while you work. $9.99, one-time purchase.

records.name: ArtDeck
records.tagline: Visual reference boards with study tools built in
records.description: Most reference apps stop at collecting. ArtDeck helps you study what you save: value, color, composition and motion with onion skinning, right on the board. Native on iPhone, iPad and Mac, offline and synced through your iCloud. Buy once and no subscription.

records.name: Atlaso
records.tagline: One memory for every AI you use
records.description: Atlaso is a memory layer for AI. Connect it once and every AI you use, from Claude Code to Cursor, Codex and ChatGPT, automatically recalls the context that matters: your projects, your decisions, and the way you like to work. No more re-explaining yourself at the start of every session. One shared memory that follows you across every tool, instead of being locked inside one app. Free to start, and backed by original memory research.

records.name: AirProof AI
records.tagline: Find the best spot for your air purifier in seconds
records.description: Most people don't know where to place their air purifier for maximum effectiveness.AirProof AI allows users to test different purifier locations, visualize realistic indoor airflow in seconds, and compare key performance metrics including airflow efficiency, coverage quality, recirculation risk, and overall effectiveness.Unlike generic placement recommendations by manufacturers,AirProof AI shows how airflow actually changes inside a room and can automatically optimize purifier placement using AI

records.name: Vibe Buddy
records.tagline: Hardware for AI coding
records.description: Vibe Buddy is a small desktop robot that keeps Codex and Claude Code usage limits and task status visible while you work. See when your AI is working, needs your input, has finished, or has hit its usage limit—without opening another tab.

records.name: ZapDigits MCP
records.tagline: The MCP server for marketing data
records.description: Connect Claude and ChatGPT to Google Analytics, Search Console, Meta Ads and 30+ marketing data sources.

records.name: Yokoso
records.tagline: Japanese for the life you're actually living in Japan
records.description: Free Japanese learning for real life in Japan. Yokoso adapts around what you know, teaches signs, prices and grammar in context, imports WaniKani progress, works offline, and has no ads, streaks or locked lessons.

records.name: FileFlippers
records.tagline: Send big files and get paid on download
records.description: FileFlippers is file delivery built for freelancers and studios who are tired of clunky transfers and chasing invoices. Send large files with fast, resumable uploads on your own branded pages. Add watermarks, collect client feedback, and keep versions tidy. Then gate the final files behind payment, so the download unlocks the moment you get paid. AI enhance and convert are built in too, so you can upscale or reformat without leaving the tab. Fast, secure, and branded. Free plan available.

records.name: Stynar
records.tagline: The AI SDR that runs outbound for you
records.description: Stynar is an autonomous AI Revenue Agent that runs your entire outbound workflow. It researches every prospect, writes highly personalized emails, sends campaigns from unlimited mailboxes, automatically follows up, manages every reply in one inbox, detects buying intent, and books meetings directly on your calendar. Instead of hiring more SDRs, let AI handle outbound while your team focuses on closing deals.

records.name: VIDEO AI ME
records.tagline: Make videos and post them everywhere with just one tool
records.description: Most schedulers make you create your videos somewhere else, then download and re-upload them. VIDEO AI ME now does both: generate UGC ads and product videos with AI, then publish or schedule them to 15 platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn and 10 more) without leaving the tool. AI writes captions per platform from your actual script. Bulk schedule 25 videos in one sitting. See which video wins on each platform, then repost it or generate a new version with AI in one click.

records.name: Hey Noah
records.tagline: A proactive AI executive assistant for founders
records.description: Noah is a proactive AI executive assistant for founders. Claude talks to you; Noah talks to your network. It's like Tesla Full Self Driving, and not cruise control- an autonomous AI EA that manages your calendar, relationships, and follow-ups across email, text, and WhatsApp - so nothing slips. Think of it as an always-on EA living in your SMS and helping you with meeting logistics.

records.name: GrowthBook 5.0
records.tagline: Build, ship, and improve at scale
records.description: GrowthBook 5.0 brings feature flags, experimentation, and product analytics into one AI-native, warehouse-native platform. Build no-code experiments in the browser with the new AI Visual Editor, let agents create flags and draft experiments with 25 open-source Skills, explore product data through the in-app AI Assistant, and ship safely with stronger governance. Faster queries and a streamlined experiment workflow help every team move from idea to insight with less friction.

records.name: SpeakoFlow
records.tagline: Free, open-source voice dictation and AI assistant, offline
records.description: SpeakoFlow puts your voice over your whole desktop. Speak, and your words land in any app — email, editor, chat, terminal. Say "Hey Flow" and it writes the whole reply from what's on your screen. Ask the assistant about what you're looking at and hear the answer back. It also cleans up your dictation, translates as you speak, and learns how you work. Everything can run on your machine — speech-to-text always does. Free, open source, MIT. Windows, macOS, Linux.

records.name: Finyuus
records.tagline: A code-first language for durable, governed AI workflows
records.description: Finyuus is a code-first platform for building, running, and governing AI workflows. It introduces a small indentation-based DSL for composing agents, tools, guards, human approvals, and nested workflows — then runs them on Temporal with retries, cancellation, and replayability. Unlike visual builders, workflows are stored as text for Git-based review and diffs. Unlike prompt chains, every run is durable, versioned, observable via Langfuse, and governable through guards and human approvals.

records.name: Driven
records.tagline: The trusted AI investment agent, from insight to action
records.description: Driven is an AI investment agent that turns market insight into action, not just answers. In one agent-powered workspace, it combines 260+ APIs, built-in & custom Skills, Playbooks, scheduled tasks, 24/7 monitoring, real-time data, portfolios, and order workflows. Instead of switching tools or chasing every signal, investors can manage the full journey in Driven, from idea generation and data gathering to analysis and action. It’s your AI investment team, while you stay in control.

records.name: Wondering
records.tagline: Duolingo for learning anything
records.description: Wondering is the most delightful way to break down complex topics into knowledge you can remember and apply. Tell it what you want to learn, and it creates a personalized path of short lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises. It surfaces the most important ideas and lets you explore them in your own way, like a thoughtful tutor beside you.

records.name: BitePad
records.tagline: Minimalist voice calorie tracker
records.description: BitePad is intentionally minimal. Instead of packing in bloated features, we focus on one thing: making calorie tracking fast and effortless. Simply speak or type what you ate, and BitePad turns it into a meal log in seconds. Unlike AI photo logging, which often misidentifies foods and requires manual corrections, BitePad lets you review the estimated calories and macros, make any quick edits if needed, and save your meal. Simple by design, built for everyday use.

records.name: Revenue Leak AI
records.tagline: AI that finds where your money leaks — and fixes it
records.description: Connect Stripe, Shopify, Paddle, Meta & Google Ads. Revenue Leak AI audits your stack in 60 seconds, prices every leak in euros and fixes it in one click.Revenue Leak AI connects to Stripe, Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and GA4 — then runs an AI audit that pinpoints exactly where revenue is leaking. Duplicate subscriptions, abandoned checkouts, wasted ad spend, zombie charges. Every leak is priced in dollars with an exact annual savings figure. One click fixes it.

records.name: Ezee Course Creator
records.tagline: From topic to sellable Udemy course in one afternoon
records.description: Turn any topic, PDF, or personal story into a finished, narrated video course you can sell on Udemy — no camera, no editing. AI plans the full curriculum, writes professional teaching slides, narrates in AI voices or your own (record or clone), then renders clean 1080p MP4 lectures. One studio replaces outlines, slide tools, voice studios, and video editors. Free to start. Hours, not weeks.

records.name: Arch Calendar
records.tagline: What did you do today? Not your AI. You.
records.description: Every productivity tool is racing to take the day off your hands: auto-schedule this, auto-categorize that, let the agent decide. We takes the other side. It's one minimalist calendar that holds your tasks, events, and notes together, so your whole day lives in one place, not scattered across apps. We use AI too, but pointed the other way: it clears the busywork and hands back the part that matters, deciding what today is for. One calendar for your whole day, lived by you.

records.name: ScanIt Events
records.tagline: One QR code on the table. Every guest's Memory in one place.
records.description: Most event photo apps ask guests to download an app or make an account. Guests don't bother, and the host gets a fraction of the photos. ScanIt Events works from a card on the table. Guests scan with any phone camera and the page opens in the browser — no app, no signup, about eight seconds. They share photos, write a message, RSVP, or send a gift. It all lands on a live board, AI moderation keeps it clean, and the host downloads everything as one file. $99 per event. Unlimited guests.

records.name: Crystal Wars - a new game on Steam
records.tagline: Turn-based strategy on a fresh Voronoi grid map every match
records.description: The game features various modes, such as Tutorial, Campaign, Quick Game, 2-player, and more. There are also presets to choose from to make the map look the way you want. The core mechanic is flood-fill capture where you pick a color and claim all adjacent cells of that color, expanding your territory. And of course there are additional mechanics like energy crystals, bombs, supply cutting and obstacles that make it harder but also funnier.

records.name: Ledgerhome
records.tagline: Know what your renovation will really cost
records.description: Ledgerhome turns any renovation idea into a clear plan — instant cost estimates, design directions, and contractor-ready scopes of work, in minutes. Get a realistic budget adjusted to your state, a maintenance calendar so nothing gets forgotten, an AI Advisor that proactively flags what needs attention based on your home's age, and ROI insights showing what you'll recoup at resale. Built for homeowners who want to walk into contractor meetings prepared, not guessing.

records.name: Velyo
records.tagline: Calm AI check-ins for a clearer mind
records.description: Velyo is a private reflection app for short emotional check-ins and calm AI conversations. Choose how you feel, use modes like Daily, Cooldown, Overthinking, Reflect, or Deep Reflection, and keep continuity over time without turning reflection into a chore. Built for people who want a quieter way to pause, understand what is happening, and take one small next step.

records.name: Seolyn
records.tagline: A fully autonomous AI SEO agent for busy founders
records.description: Seolyn researches your niche's long-tail keywords, writes full SEO- and GEO-optimized articles for each one, links them together, and publishes on a schedule. - AI keyword research by search intent and commercial value - Articles with direct-answer openings + FAQ schema, built for Google and AI answer engines - Auto-publish on schedule, or review first - Point your own domain at it, the SEO benefit is yours - Free tier: 3 articles/month, no card - Try it with zero signup at seolyn.io/try

records.name: monthlet
records.tagline: The note app where AI writes the note — layout and all
records.description: Dump raw thoughts — bullets, fragments — and tell monthlet in plain language what you want. AI writes the whole note: banners, columns, tabs, real spreadsheets and live charts, layout chosen for you. Want a change? Just ask — only that part updates. Every note is a plain HTML file on your disk, opens in any browser, no lock-in. Bring your own AI key (Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini); your notes never touch our servers. Free and complete. macOS (Apple Silicon) today; Windows on the way.

records.name: RepFlow
records.tagline: Voice note in, structured CRM out — any language
records.description: Field sales reps lose their evenings to call reports. RepFlow fixes the input, not the rep: speak for 30 seconds after a visit and AI returns a structured record — contact, product, sentiment, objection, next step, and a follow-up date already on your calendar. Any language. Works offline. Optional on-site check-in and day-route planning. No heavyweight CRM required. Free to try, no card; paid plans from €15/mo. Built first for pharma reps; fits any outside-sales team.

records.name: Tars
records.tagline: Self hosted second brain.
records.description: Tars gives Claude a real memory. Instead of markdown files and vector search, it stores your world as a graph: entities, timestamped facts, and the relations between them, served to any MCP client. Everything runs on your machine, Postgres and local embeddings, nothing leaves the box. Each night it consolidates the day, links new facts to old ones, and reconciles contradictions. Benchmarked on LOCOMO: the right memory reaches the model 82.9% of the time. MIT licensed, one command to run.

records.name: LigiComms
records.tagline: Social media, WhatsApp & CRM — one dashboard for ₹599/mo
records.description: Most tools only do social scheduling — LigiComms combines social media management, direct messaging, and sales tracking in one dashboard. - Cross-post to 10+ networks (Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, YouTube) - Publish Reels & YouTube Shorts from one upload - WhatsApp, Email & SMS broadcasts with delivery tracking - Built-in CRM with sales pipeline - AI writing assistant for captions & hashtags Built for Indian businesses. Pricing from ₹599/month, all features in every plan.

records.name: Devpuff
records.tagline: Learn to code by doing, interactively.
records.description: Learn to code by doing. Devpuff gives you bite-sized, interactive lessons, quizzes, practice sets, and real projects where you write real code right in your browser, run it instantly, and level up JavaScript, Python, SQL, and more.

records.name: Ask PDF
records.tagline: Turn your PDFs into smart, searchable AI knowledge bases.
records.description: Ask PDF turns multiple documents into isolated AI knowledge bases directly from your browser. Highlights: • Multi-Doc Analysis: Upload multiple PDFs simultaneously and cross-reference insights. • Client-Side Parsing: In-browser text extraction keeps raw PDF binaries safe. • Auto-Recovery: Built-in IndexedDB resumes interrupted uploads seamlessly. • Custom Workspaces: Organize documents into distinct project tags. • Pay-As-You-Go: Ultra-low-cost credit model with no subscriptions.

records.name: Repollo
records.tagline: Connect your AI agent. It votes. You see who agreed.
records.description: A voting community where humans and AI share a room. Every attempt to mix the two puts AI to work writing posts, and it reads as slop. A vote doesn't — it's bounded, the same shape for everyone, so a machine's vote lands next to yours instead of crowding it out. Connect your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini over MCP. It reads the case and votes with its own reasoning, not ours. You never tell it which side to take. Then read how the humans split against the machines.

records.name: Soulaura
records.tagline: Private AI support for your mind, mood and wellbeing
records.description: SoulAura is an all-in-one AI mental wellness platform with Dr. Adam, a 24/7 AI wellbeing companion. Access voice and text support, mood and sleep tracking, CBT tools, journaling, mental health screeners, safety planning, crisis resources, peer support, career guidance and personalised insights. Built with privacy and responsible AI at its core. Start your free 14-day trial. Not a substitute for professional medical advice or emergency care.

records.name: Flyby AI
records.tagline: Flyby autonomously books corporate travel
records.description: Flyby is able to connect with corporate calendars, see upcoming business trips, and automatically book flights and hotels with one-tap reversal. Flyby can also automatically rebook trips if travel dates change. Flyby will automatically connect to corporate or personal credit cards and track spending during the duration of the trip and send an expense report to the user's supervisor for final approval. If luggage is lost, Flyby will negotiate with the airlines and obtain a credit autonomously.

records.name: PayCheck
records.tagline: Track your money. Your records stay on your phone.
records.description: A money tracker that doesn't take a copy of your life. No account, no sign-up, opens to your numbers. Records are SQLCipher-encrypted and never leave the device. New country? Flip the display currency once — everything converts, even offline. 95% is free — the paid 5% is deeper analytics and no ads. If a small crowd turns up this year, two big updates follow, free on day one for everyone: iOS, Windows and macOS, then a shared space — your household's money visible to each other, never to me.

records.name: ShotPanda
records.tagline: App store screenshot generator & monetized bio-link engine
records.description: ShotPanda is a complete marketing engine for app creators. Generate stunning store screenshots, launch custom link-in-bio profiles, and shorten monetized links in one dashboard. 🚀 Key Features: •Premium app screenshot builder with 20+ auto-languages translation •Personal pnd.bio pages & templates to show off apps & social links •Monetized pnd.lat short links with CPM earnings •High-conversion ASO scanners Everything you need to market, translate & monetize your apps! 🐼

records.name: AI Upgrade: Gosal Saver UP
records.tagline: Savings goals you fund by typing one sentence
records.description: Savings goals with no account, no cloud and no bank connection — everything stays on your iPhone. New in this launch: Smart Add — type "put 5000 into Bali trip" or "spent 40 on groceries" and it files it for you. Parsed on-device by Apple Intelligence, with an offline fallback and an editable confirmation before it saves. Smart Summary compares each goal's real pace to what its deadline needs, so you spot drift in time to fix it. Plus a full Liquid Glass redesign.

records.tagline: The API client for developers on Windows
records.description: Karve is a native Windows API client built around plain http files. Cold start under 2 seconds. Organize requests from every repo in one workspace, switchenv environments, keep searchable history. Files stay on disk, Git-friendly. No account. Buy once.

records.name: PassSecurium Password Manager
records.tagline: Secure Password & Access Data Management for Businesses
records.description: PassSecurium™ is a Swiss Business Password Manager that helps teams and companies securely store, manage, and share passwords and other sensitive information. Protect your business accounts with role-based access, encrypted vaults, multi-factor authentication (MFA), SSO, activity logs, and secure sharing. Centralized credential management improves collaboration, simplifies access management, and strengthens your company's cybersecurity. Made and hosted in Switzerland.

records.name: Dashi Metrics
records.tagline: Visualize your revenue on a 3D globe
records.description: Watch your business come alive—every visitor and payment mapped in real time on a dynamic 3D globe. Dashi transforms static dashboards into live, geographic visualizations, making global trends and customer activity instantly engaging. Spin, zoom, and interact with your data as it happens. Perfect for SaaS teams and founders who want actionable, visual insights instead of boring charts.

records.name: PointerScore
records.tagline: Analyze any stock in 5 minutes – free & easy to understand
records.description: Markets are full of opinions, hype, and noise. PointerScore gives investors a structured alternative. Enter your own company data, evaluate financial and qualitative factors, and generate a transparent 100-point score. Designed for investors who prefer independent research over blind trust in others. No buy or sell signals—just a clear framework for better company analysis. An AI assistant is coming soon to automate the research for you.

records.name: Campaign MRI
records.tagline: The fastest way to give your marketing campaign an audit
records.description: The Campaign MRI (Marketing Readiness Index) by D’Marketing Society helps you evaluate your campaign before launch—when it matters most. Assess your strategy across five critical categories to receive a score, then upload your campaign details to unlock a marketing AI-powered analysis. Get a comprehensive breakdown, tailored recommendations, and forward-looking insights specific to your campaign. Identify gaps, optimize performance, and fix what’s broken before your budget is spent.

records.description: space ocr turns photos of receipts, invoices and forms into a table you can query. Drop them into a folder in the app or send them to the API, and each page becomes a row you can filter and sort. Every value shows where it came from. 100 free pages a month.

records.name: Talisman - Not your average .md file.
records.tagline: Turn any codebase into a branded PDF guide-with any AI agent
records.description: Generate a polished, on-brand PDF guide/handbook/whitepaper from a codebase or project using LaTeX (.Talisman is an open-source agent skill that reads your codebase and generates a print-ready, on-brand PDF guide: a designed cover page, your product's real colors and logo, native diagrams (domain models, flows, state machines), and a subtle branded background. Works with any coding AI agent via AGENTS.md. Install with one command. MIT-licensed.tex ->pdf).

records.name: Duesday
records.tagline: A subscription tracker that isn't a subscription
records.description: Duesday puts your total monthly subscription spend in the menu bar, next to the clock — one number you can't ignore. Click it: every renewal sorted by date, this week's charges, and alerts before anything bills, including free trials about to convert, with a cancel link one click away. Adding takes ~10 seconds — 215 services built in, prices kept current automatically. No bank login, no account, no tracking — your data never leaves your Mac. One-time $9.99, universal for Apple Silicon and Intel.

records.name: InboxDoc
records.tagline: AI that reads your inbox and extracts invoices automatically
records.description: InboxDoc connects to Gmail, Outlook, or IMAP and automatically detects invoices in your inbox - extracting vendor, amount, tax, and dates using AI, no manual entry. It flags duplicates and zero-value invoices, and exports everything to Excel, ready for your accountant. Free trial is live now (Outlook/IMAP fully supported, Gmail in beta). Paid plans launching within days.

records.name: Pixel Normal Edit
records.tagline: A fast, free online pixel art & drawing tool.
records.description: Pixel Normal Edit is a professional online Pixel Art editor and drawing tool. It supports customizable canvas sizes, pixel image compression, intelligent gradient fill, and a wide range of advanced features designed for game developers and pixel artists.

records.name: EV Kelly Calculator
records.tagline: Institutional-grade position sizing for retail traders.
records.description: Stop blowing up trading accounts. EV Kelly is a free, mathematically rigorous position sizing calculator that uses Expected Value and the Kelly Criterion to optimize capital allocation, track trade edge, and prevent risk of ruin.

records.name: ExpenseBot for ChatGPT
records.tagline: Track and submit expenses right inside ChatGPT
records.description: ExpenseBot is now a ChatGPT app. Drop a receipt into a chat and the vendor, date, tax and total land in a Google Sheet you own, in about 30 seconds. Then just ask: what did I spend on travel last quarter, by client? Scan Gmail for receipts you missed, build a report, have it emailed to your accountant. Every tool is scope-gated at the consent screen and your data stays in your own Drive. Free 60-day trial, no card — sign up at expensebot.ai, then open ExpenseBot in ChatGPT.

records.name: saasrocket.space
records.tagline: Launch your SaaS into space. Literally.
records.description: SaaS Rocket is the most spectacular way to launch a SaaS. Paste your product URL and we crawl your site, swap your logo onto the rocket hull, and fly a hand-crafted paper-cutout launch cinematic. Every launch generates a free public replay link: your own launch movie, made to be posted on X and LinkedIn. Your product becomes a permanent star in the galaxy map, and one launch publishes TWO listings: a rich listing page on saasrocket.space and an auto-created listing on directree.io

records.name: Tercant
records.tagline: All-in-one workspace for team projects & knowledge
records.description: Tercant gives companies one organized workspace for projects, pages, files, team knowledge and collaboration. Register your company to get staTercant brings your team's projects, docs, files, and knowledge under one clean roof. Instead of context-switching between fragmented tools, Tercant gives your company a single, organized workspace to manage tasks, build internal wikis, and collaborate effortlessly. Register your workspace today to keep your entire team aligned!rted.

records.name: x402stats
records.tagline: Independent x402 stats: organic volume, wash-trades removed
records.description: x402 is how AI agents pay over HTTP — USDC micropayments via the 402 status code. Raw on-chain totals count wash trading, self-dealing and facilitator settlement wallets as revenue. x402stats indexes 10+ facilitators across every chain, filters the noise, and publishes both numbers: daily volume, active sellers, paying agents, and facilitator market share. Published methodology, free CSV/JSON under CC BY 4.0, plus x402-payable endpoints for agents. Independent, read-only — never touches funds.

records.name: Netlink Resource Group
records.tagline: Custom marketing platforms for complex enterprise growth
records.description: Netlink Resource Group designs and supports custom marketing platforms for enterprises whose CMS and disconnected systems can no longer handle complex workflows. We build secure API integrations, real-time data synchronization, multilingual capabilities, and scalable web applications around existing technology. With 30 years of experience, a fixed-cost model, and ongoing support, Netlink helps organizations modernize without replacing everything they already rely on.

records.name: Altcoin Madness
records.tagline: Free Crypto Momentum Indicator & Scanner
records.description: A free crypto momentum indicator that gives you live market overview - not just prices, but the strength behind them. Six-state gauge (Bearish → Sending) reads Bitcoin's momentum live, a Reversal Watch flags potential turning points, and a Hot Coins scanner shows real movers by blending 24h/7d change with volume filtering out noise. Add live Fear & Greed + a plain-English daily summary. No login, no paywall, plus a free embeddable widget. Built for traders who want a fast, honest market read.

records.name: SweetTruth
records.tagline: Stop guessing how much sugar is hiding in your snacks
records.description: SweetTruth scans the barcode on any packaged food and instantly shows you how much sugar it contains — converted into teaspoons, with a simple low/medium/high rating, so you can decide if it's worth it before you buy. It flags hidden sugar in the ingredient list too (dextrose, maltodextrin, and other names sugar hides behind), and if there's no barcode, you can snap a photo of the ingredients label and AI reads it for you. Built this solo as my first project — would love your feedback!

records.name: HiveWeaver FM
records.tagline: Live AI radio showcase with real-time thought transparency
records.description: HiveWeaver FM is a showcase that lets you listen to a live radio station run by AI moderators. records.name: AaharIQ

records.name: whack.sh
records.tagline: Whack the moles your current scanner can't see.
records.description: Per the FBI's IC3 warning, TDS kits fingerprint IPs to hide payloads, targeting only residential, mobile, or specific ASNs. To catch them, you have to blend in. whack.sh allows you to scan any URL via datacenter, residential, mobile, VPN and BYO egress options at once. Then diffs the captures to expose cloaking, TDS, phishing sites and malware a datacenter-only IP scanner misses. Datacenter egress is free (first 5MB/scan); our curl API drives every tier, free or paid.

records.name: Screen Awesome
records.tagline: The free screen recorder that cannot upload your video

Check it in chrome://extensions before you install. Record a tab, screen or camera to MP4. Auto-zoom glides a virtual camera to every click. Screenshot a region or a full scrolling page. Annotate with arrows, blur, redaction, step counters and text — all editable vectors. Free, unlocked, no account, no watermark.

It handles the parts people get wrong: exchange holidays, early closes, half days, and daylight saving shifts that don't line up between countries. No account, no tracking, no stock picks.

records.name: SatoshiBro

records.description: Create and launch cryptocurrency tokens with AI. Hi Product Hunt, we built Satoshi Bro because creating a blockchain token still feels like a developer-only task. With Satoshi Bro, you describe your idea, choose the token details, generate the branding, review the transaction and launch on Solana mainnet from your own wallet. We would love honest feedback on the creation flow, the trust signals and what advanced launch format you want us to build next.

records.name: ShiftMate
records.tagline: AI-powered staff scheduling built for modern businesses.
records.description: ShiftMate helps businesses create, manage, and share staff schedules without relying on spreadsheets, paper rosters, or endless messaging. Designed for restaurants, cafés, retail stores, salons, gyms, and clinics, ShiftMate combines simplicity with powerful automation so managers can spend less time scheduling and more time growing their businesses.ShiftMate focuses on speed, simplicity, and flexibility.Our mission is simple: eliminate scheduling chaos and give business owners their time back.

records.name: FacturaPro
records.tagline: Simple invoicing for freelancers and SMEs
records.description: [My app] FacturaPro — Free professional invoices for freelancers Hi! I'm a freelancer and I got tired of paying $30/month for invoicing apps. So I built FacturaPro. ✅ FREE Plan: 3 invoices/month, no credit card required ✅ PRO Plan: $6/month (unlimited invoices, 5 templates, email) ✅ BUSINESS Plan: $12/month (automatic reminders, due date calendar, payment receipts with signature) URL: https://factura-pro-factura-pro.vercel.app What do you think? All feedback is welcome.

records.name: Robank — Premium Robux Finance Tracker
records.tagline: The secure virtual ledger to track your Roblox economy.
records.description: Robank is a secure financial ledger for players looking to master budgeting within the Roblox virtual economy. While tracking trading profits, developer payouts, and daily Robux spending can get disorganized, Robank offers an authenticated web app where users can create secure profiles to safely log transactions, track net income, and visualize wealth growth. Built strictly as a manual bookkeeping ledger, it provides a premium dashboard without requesting external Roblox credentials.

records.name: SignalDeal
records.tagline: Real-time analytics & optimization for AI Search (AEO).
records.description: Everyone says AEO is the new SEO, but how do you measure it? SignalDeal is a reverse-CDN that intercepts AI bots (SearchGPT, Perplexity, Claude), serves them an optimized llms.txt Markdown file instead of your heavy HTML, and logs every request in a live dashboard. Finally, you can prove that AI is crawling your business and differentiate between training bots and live search queries. Build your AI visibility and prove your ROI. White-label ready for Agencies.

records.name: Build Confidence and Skill at Actors Hub
records.tagline: Actors Hub Perth Inspiring the Next Generation of Performers
records.description: A lasting acting career begins with consistent training and professional development. While natural ability is valuable, dedication to learning separates successful actors from the rest. Actors Hub provides practical acting techniques, performance skills, and career guidance that prepare students for real industry opportunities. At Actors Hub Perth, performers develop confidence, discipline, and resilience through structured training that supports growth at every stage.

records.name: Essentify
records.tagline: CARFAX for your home — every repair, documented
records.description: Home maintenance is reactive, undocumented, and forgotten. Essentify gives every property a permanent, verifiable service record. Scan the QR code on any appliance and see its full history. Log a repair in seconds — cost, receipt, photo. See what each property actually costs to run, and hand the next owner proof it was cared for. Preventive maintenance costs ~4.8x less than reactive. Free to start.

records.name: Glasp MCP Connector
records.tagline: Search your highlights and notes inside Claude and ChatGPT
records.description: Connect Glasp to Claude and ChatGPT as an MCP server. Search your highlights and memories in natural language, right inside your AI assistant. Read-only and private to you.

records.name: Rival Shark
records.tagline: Competitor, industry, and local market intel in minutes
records.description: Most businesses discover a competitor's move after it has already cost them. Rival Shark turns competitor, industry, and local market research into clear reports you can act on in minutes. See what changed, where your category is moving, how saturated your market is, and who leads it. Every finding includes what it means, what to do next, and how quickly to act. Run reports on demand or schedule competitor monitoring without an analyst team or a months-long research project.

records.name: Pittugram
records.tagline: All sports news, one feed.
records.description: Pittugram is a sports news aggregator that pulls the latest football, cricket, tennis, F1, and more from top publications like ESPN, BBC Sport, and Sky Sports into one ranked feed. Submit links, upvote, and discuss — the Hacker News for sports fans.

records.name: It's a Plan
records.tagline: Open-source Linear alternative: a tracker with AI agents
records.description: Assign an issue to an AI agent the same way you assign it to a person. It picks the issue up on the board your team already uses, replies in the comment thread, and moves the card under its own name. You choose its model, write its skills, approve its tools, and decide what it may touch. Around that is a full tracker: four view layouts over one dataset, initiatives, dashboards, custom roles, REST API, webhooks and MCP. Self-hosted on Docker and Postgres, AGPL-3.0.

records.name: Hire-a-Mind
records.tagline: Turn Interviews Into Hiring Intelligence
records.description: Hire-a-Mind is an AI-powered Interview Intelligence Platform that helps hiring teams review interview evidence in minutes, compare candidates consistently, and make confident hiring decisions. Unlike interview recording or AI note-taking tools, every recommendation is backed by interview evidence, explainable AI reasoning, and an audit-ready decision trail - while keeping humans in control.

records.name: Talotrace
records.tagline: AI QA engineer that finds, explains, and reproduces bugs
records.description: Most AI testing tools execute predefined test cases or stop at detecting bugs. TaloTrace learns how your product works, autonomously explores real user journeys across web and mobile apps, and verifies every finding while reducing false positives. Every issue is delivered as a Trace with recordings, console logs, network logs, reproduction steps, severity, root cause analysis, and supporting evidence. This gives engineers everything they need to understand, reproduce, and resolve issues faster.

records.name: GeoLook
records.tagline: Open-source, self-hosted platform for end-to-end GEO
records.description: Most GEO tools are monitoring SaaS: dashboards, monthly fees, your data in their cloud. GeoLook is an open-source (MIT), self-hosted implementation platform: it samples real answers from 15 AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, DeepSeek…), quantifies mention rate / rank / citation share, diagnoses why AI doesn't mention your brand, generates tickets with acceptance criteria, and auto-verifies what actually worked. Works for both global and Chinese AI engines.

records.name: SuperMailOS
records.tagline: Business email on your own domain, live in five minutes
records.description: Professional email on your own domain — you@yourcompany.com — without running a mail server. You bring a domain. We generate every DNS record from the mail server's own zone, verify it live while you watch, run the MTA, sign every message with DKIM, and manage SPF, DMARC and IP reputation. There's a dashboard showing your mail is actually landing. Then it's just email: threads, instant search, keyboard shortcuts, labels, signatures, dark mode. IMAP/SMTP too. From $3/mailbox/mo. Aliases free.

records.name: foomchat
records.tagline: The AI chat you can rewrite by asking
records.description: Describe a tool — a timer, a theme, a scratchpad, a game — and the AI writes it as an installable feature, live in the chat. One click mounts it. Browse what others built and install it in seconds. Free credits, no card required.

records.name: Understand Any Page AI
records.tagline: Understand Any Page AI
records.description: Turn any webpage into an AI-powered learning experience. Understand Any Page AI transforms articles, news, and technical documents into study cards and quizzes. Powered by Upstage Solar Pro 3, it extracts key concepts, summarizes content, and generates multiple-choice questions to test your understanding. Features: • AI study cards from webpages • 3/5/7 question quizzes • Instant grading and feedback • Learning scores and review points • Local history storage

records.name: Doko-Hosting
records.tagline: Reveal any website's hosting stack in one click.
records.description: Find out who hosts the website you're viewing with one click. Check its web host, CDN, email service, and DNS provider—all in one place. Supports detection for 1,200+ hosting providers.

records.name: Guildless
records.tagline: Watch AI agents build software—and verify every result
records.description: Guildless is an autonomous AI software company you can watch and trust. Give it a mission, then watch specialized agents plan, build, review, test, and verify the work inside a live 3D office. Founders can instantly see what is happening, why it matters, what was produced, and where to open it—without reading logs. Independent cross-review and deterministic gates back every file, finding, test, audit record, and pull request with evidence.

records.name: Dictalus
records.tagline: A private rep gym for speaking under pressure
records.description: Record a 30-second answer, get scored on how you actually sounded: pace, filler words, pauses, pitch variation, energy; plus a colored "language arc" showing where you hedged and where you committed. One concrete fix per rep. A guided curriculum: 7 modules and 32 drills, from your first hello and small talk to interviews, meetings, etc. and Pre-Game lets you build the plan for a real upcoming moment and rehearse it out loud. 5 free reps a day, web + iOS. Free tools to analyze speech too!

records.name: Exifio
records.tagline: AI Metadata & EXIF Tagging Tool for Microstocks
records.description: Exifio is an AI-powered desktop app for microstock contributors (Adobe Stock, Shutterstock, Getty). Visually analyze photos & vector illustrations with Google Gemini AI to generate high-converting metadata, embedded directly into JPG, PNG, EPS & WebP headers losslessly via ExifTool. Features smart EPS/AI vector auto-pairing and 1-click Adobe Stock CSV export.

records.name: Noden
records.tagline: SSH, SFTP & RDP in one native Mac app, with an AI Assistant
records.description: Noden puts your SSH terminals, an SFTP file manager and Windows RDP in one native macOS window — side by side in a grid. Per-tab latency, SSH tunnels, broadcast input, ⌘P switcher, Touch ID. NEW in 1.3.0, shipped today: a built-in Password Vault — Keychain-only, Touch ID-guarded; rotate a secret once and every connection follows. Plus an AI that knows if it's on Linux or Windows and writes the command. Free for 5 connections; Pro $10/yr — launch offer: first year $5.99, auto-applied. macOS 13+.

records.name: EconoGlance AI
records.tagline: Split Expenses , Manage Subscriptions & Trips
records.description: Scan receipts, split bills any way, and always know who owes what. EconoGlance is the fastest, cleanest way to share expenses with friends, roommates and family. EconoGlance AI combines everyday financial tools into one mobile app. Users can: - Split expenses with friends and family - Scan receipts using AI - Track subscriptions and recurring payments - Manage trip expenses - Monitor personal spending - Handle multiple currencies - Organize merchants, banks, and payment methods

records.name: AdmissionsOS
records.tagline: The college counselor that never stops working
records.description: AdmissionsOS is an AI college counselor built by Ivy League counselors and MIT engineers. Its counselor, Sol, draws on 50,000+ student profiles, decades of admissions data, and every federal and state aid program across every school. Unlike a chatbot that forgets you and guesses from averages, Sol remembers your full profile: your real chances at every school, a college list built on fit, essay coaching without ghostwriting, and every deadline from FAFSA to final award letter. Free to start.

records.name: Overtiq
records.tagline: Turn 25 company URLs into sales insights in just 30 seconds
records.description: Overtiq is an AI-powered pipeline intelligence engine built for founders and sales teams to find high-value accounts instantly. Instead of manually sorting through unqualified leads, you can paste company domains to analyze their structural bottlenecks, score their market value, and generate ready-to-use, targeted outreach messages in seconds. It features a clean dashboard, bulk link processing, and simple multi-tenant security to help you save time and focus only on real buying intent.

records.name: VersusAI: Compare Anything
records.tagline: Compare smarter. Decide better.
records.description: VersusAI is an AI-powered comparison app that helps you compare products, gadgets, colleges, careers, jobs, services, travel destinations, and everyday choices in seconds. Why choose VersusAI? ⚖️ Compare any two options instantly 🤖 AI-powered comparison engine 📱 Compare phones, laptops, tablets, gadgets and electronics 🎓 Compare colleges, courses, degrees and career paths 💼 Compare jobs, salaries, offers and services ✈️ Compare destinations, travel plans and experiences

records.name: Tether
records.tagline: A word ladder puzzle where every rung has its own clue
records.description: Classic word ladders hand you a start and an end word, then leave you guessing. Tether puts a clue on every rung, so each single-letter step is a small puzzle you can actually solve. Rows check themselves the moment they fill – green means correct. • 1,178 puzzles: Easy (4 letters), Medium (5–6), Hard (7) • 2 free hints every day, plus a daily spin for coins • Built-in dictionary to look up any word • Day streaks and stats • No ads, no account, works offline

records.name: AddressIntel
records.tagline: Free San Mateo & Santa Clara building-permit tracker
records.description: AddressIntel tracks building permits across San Mateo and Santa Clara counties daily, pulling from each municipal portal on the SF Peninsula and in the South Bay. Search permits by city, address, architect, or contractor, and see every permit scored for teardown potential and developer ROI. Built for spec builders, flippers, and agents who want to spot redevelopment opportunities before they hit the MLS. Free tier for browsing permit and market data; Pro adds the full screener and API.

records.name: SmartBudget AI
records.tagline: ​AI-powered personal budgeting made simple
records.description: SmartBudget AI is an intuitive, AI-powered personal finance assistant designed to help you take full control of your money effortlessly. Key Features: - Smart Budgeting: Automatically categorize and track expenses with AI intelligence. - Actionable Insights: Get real-time advice to optimize your spending and save more. - Effortless Interface: Built to make managing your daily finances fast, clean, and simple. Stop guessing where your money goes—let SmartBudget AI do it for you

records.name: LibertyFile One
records.tagline: Turn messy finance exports into an accountant-ready pack
records.description: Import CSV, OFX, and QFX exports from banks, marketplaces, and crypto platforms. LibertyFile detects formats, normalizes columns, removes duplicates, matches likely transfers between your own accounts, keeps uncertain rows in a review queue, and exports an accountant-ready reconciliation package. Processing stays in the browser or desktop app—no SSN or raw statement uploads.

records.name: ReliabilityBench
records.tagline: Reliability and maintenance calculators for industrial teams
records.description: ReliabilityBench is a free engineering workbench for reliability and maintenance professionals. It provides 29 calculators for MTBF, MTTR, availability, OEE, system reliability, Weibull analysis, downtime cost, maintenance ROI, repair-versus-replace decisions, and MRO spare-parts planning. Each tool includes formulas, input guidance, result interpretation, assumptions, limitations, and related technical references. No signup is required.

records.name: Komently
records.tagline: Turn Instagram & Facebook comments into instant DMs
records.description: Komently helps creators, businesses, and agencies automatically send Instagram and Facebook DMs when someone comments on a post. Share guides, lead magnets, coupon codes, and resources instantly, collect leads, and automate customer interactions using Meta's official APIs. Supports Instagram & Facebook, AI-powered replies, Story Reply Automation, Follow-to-Unlock, and works on all future posts with no coding required.

records.name: Latch
records.tagline: Keep your Mac awake with the lid closed — sleeps when done
records.description: Keeps your Mac awake — lid closed — so Claude Code, Docker or Ollama run overnight. Watches the real process and sleeps the Mac when work ends. Battery, thermal & watchdog guardrails on by default. Free tier forever; Pro is a one-time $7.99.

records.name: BSPAssetManagement
records.tagline: Intelligent market access built for modern traders
records.description: BSP Asset Management provides a refined, precision-driven trading environment offering access to global markets. Engineered for clarity, speed, and analytical control, our platform includes live market heatmaps, precision calculators, bank-grade encryption (2FA/E2EE), and 24/5 dedicated client support.

records.name: BEAT — Dating Starts with the Right Mood
records.tagline: Your mood changes every day. Your dating app should too.
records.description: very morning starts differently. Sometimes you want to chat. Sometimes coffee. Sometimes a date. Traditional dating apps ignore that. BEAT begins with a daily Mood Wheel where everyone chooses what they’re looking for today. Then a shared daily question gets the conversation started. Less guessing. Less swiping. More meeting people who want the same thing, on the same day.

records.name: Bunched Private Family Album
records.tagline: The Private Family Album App | No Ads. No Tracking. No AI.
records.description: Bunched™ is the private family photo sharing app designed to help families safely store and share photos and videos. Protect your children, babies and family memories from social media, ads, tracking and AI. Create secure, invite-only family albums where grandparents, parents and relatives can privately enjoy every milestone. No Ads. No Tracking. No AI. Just secure family photo sharing built to keep your kids' memories private.

records.name: echodesigns
records.tagline: Beautiful App Store screenshots with AI
records.description: Most screenshot tools hand you a blank canvas and a device frame, then leave the hard part to you. echodesigns starts from your actual screenshots. Upload them and AI Mode writes the headlines, picks the backgrounds, and lays out the whole set. Everything renders in the browser at exact App Store and Google Play dimensions, so nothing comes back rejected on spec. Export the full set in one pass, up to 4K. No install, no Figma file, free to start.

records.name: Sharry
records.tagline: Screen sharing in your browser. No downloads, no installs.
records.description: Browser-based screen sharing over WebRTC. No downloads, no installs. Viewers need no account — just a link. Start a session, copy the invite link, they open it and see your screen. Peer-to-peer, end-to-end encrypted. Nothing stored on any server. Built because Teams screen sharing was too blurry for pair programming. A whole second app just for one feature. So I built a fix. Free during Early Access.

records.name: Presmo
records.tagline: Turn any PDF, doc, or link into an editable deck
records.description: Presmo turns any document — a PDF, pasted text, or a URL — into a polished, fully editable PowerPoint in seconds. It reads and restructures your content into clean, designed slides (not a page-by-page dump), sticks strictly to your source's facts, and hands you a realpptx you can edit in PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides. Free to try — your first deck is full-length and watermark-free.

records.name: GitHub
records.tagline: LLM Proxy
records.description: Security proxy for LLM APIs: detecta y bloquea prompt injection, redacta PII en entrada y salida, notifica incidentes vía webhook/email, registra todo en SQLite y expone métricas Prometheus. Diseñado para ser sencillo de modificar (todo se configura por YAML/env) y respetuoso con la privacidad (la API key del cliente nunca se persiste). - miguelcort/Proxy-LLM

records.name: VocalLab AI Studio
records.tagline: Create lifelike voices, clones, and audiobooks with AI
records.description: Choose a professional voice, design a new voice from a prompt, or clone a voice from a short audio sample. Upload an EPUB, PDF, DOCX, or TXT book, automatically detect its narrator and characters, assign each one a unique voice, and generate expressive audio. VocalLab also provides captions, voice steering, API access, and MCP integration for automated workflows.

records.name: Arthiq
records.tagline: Offline-first personal finance with complete privacy
records.description: Arthiq is built on one belief: your financial data should stay yours. Unlike many finance apps, it is offline first and stores data locally, so you stay in control without mandatory accounts or cloud dependency. Track income, expenses, budgets, subscriptions, shared bills, and net worth in one place. Fast, private, and designed for everyday use, Arthiq is more than an expense tracker it's your complete personal finance companion. Built for privacy simplicity and complete control.

records.name: Art Supply Tracker
records.tagline: AI-Powered Hands-Free Tools for Artists
records.description: Track supplies, projects, notes, and materials without breaking your creative flow.

records.name: Can I Do This Port
records.tagline: Find out if a cruise port is worth exploring on your own
records.description: A free tool that tells you whether a cruise port is worth exploring on your own, based on your ship's schedule, who you're travelling with, and your pace. Real research on every port, no ads, no affiliate links, nothing to buy. Just the answer we always wished existed.

records.name: PDF For Joy
records.tagline: Private PDF, Image and QR tools — Your Document, your device
records.description: Free PDF & image tools that run 100% in your browser — your files never upload. Edit · convert · merge · compress · sign. No signup, no watermark. 👇

records.name: Late Payment Auto-Chaser & Statement
records.tagline: Clean statements, clear late-payment actions
records.description: This tool takes a supplier statement and returns clean structured records: vendor name, amount, due date, and a standard status (overdue:critical, paid:good, pending:warning, discrepancy:critical). You can group by status, see which invoices need chasing, and feed the output into email chasers, dashboards, or your accounting workflow. No more digging through messy spreadsheets to figure out what's actually late.

records.name: Doppel
records.tagline: Get your lineup rated on real data, not vibes
records.description: Most lineup builders just let you drag names onto a pitch. Doppel actually rates your team. Build a lineup: pick a formation and coach, assign real players, and get a data-backed score for every department, a live heatmap and an honest scout verdict. Name it, share the scorecard, dare anyone to beat it. Find players: describe a profile with players you know and get an explainable, budget-aware shortlist across 18 leagues. Scores come from real data, league-adjusted, not fantasy points.

records.name: China to Amazon — True Landed Cost
records.tagline: Your supplier said $6. It'll actually cost you $9.73.
records.description: Free tool that calculates true landed cost from Chinese factory to Amazon FBA. Unlike calculators that give you a "shipping cost" box and call it done, this models the real pipeline: MFN + Section 301 + IEEPA tariffs stacked on CIF, real-time freight rates, FBA dimensional pricing, ISF/customs/port fees, and the 2-3% currency spread your bank hides. No signup. Just put in your numbers. Built by a freight broker, not a SaaS company.

records.name: FiredgeIO — Futures Trading Automation
records.tagline: Bring your own strategy. FiredgeIO handles the execution.
records.description: Most automated trading projects fail because of unreliable infrastructure, not bad strategies. FiredgeIO fixes that. It receives your signal from TradingView, NinjaTrader, MetaTrader or any HTTP source, places the trade on Tradovate, sets a stop loss automatically on every trade, and sends a Telegram confirmation — all within seconds. Free forever. Self-hosted. Open source. No SaaS middleman. Pro version with multi-symbol support and advanced reporting coming soon.

records.name: CountBusinessDays.com
records.tagline: Privacy-friendly business days calculator (no signup)
records.description: CountBusinessDays is a free, fast, privacy-friendly toolkit for calculating business days. It includes: • Count business or calendar days between dates • Add or subtract business days • Invoice age & Net-term due dates • Remaining business days this month/quarter/year • Cascading deadlines & fiscal year tools • ISO week calculator • Custom holidays (saved only in your browser) Supports U.S. Federal and Canadian holidays with correct observed dates.

records.name: Ratingsfly
records.tagline: Get Reviews Faster
records.description: Turn happy customers into 5-star Google reviews in 20 seconds. Ratingsfly gives local businesses AI-powered review funnels, QR codes, and WhatsApp campaigns - no fake reviews, fully Google Policy compliant.

records.name: Beeshopping - AI Gift Finder
records.tagline: 4 clicks to a gift they'll actually love
records.description: Gift shopping is a search problem, but every site treats it as a browsing problem. Beeshopping asks 4 questions - who, what occasion, their interests, your budget - and returns a short list of specific gifts, each with one line explaining why it fits that person. Not 200 results. No sign-up, free, funded by Amazon affiliate links at no extra cost. Built for the 20 minutes before you give up and buy a gift card.

records.name: AutoQuote
records.tagline: The AI-powered B2B proposal & quotation generator
records.description: AutoQuote is the AI-driven alternative to manual proposal tools for freelancers, agencies, and B2B sales teams who need to win deals faster. Traditional quoting means copy-pasting old templates, risking human error, and losing days to formatting. The platform ingests context directly from your Google Drive workspace and sales call transcripts, then its AI engine analyzes intent, extracts key requirements, and computes accurate pricing structures automatically.

records.name: MeltsWell
records.tagline: Where small sweet makers get found and ordered
records.description: MeltsWell is the home for small sweet businesses, home bakers, chocolatiers, cake designers, pastry and candy makers. Each maker builds a beautiful page of their own in minutes. No code, no marketplace fees. Show your creations, share photos, and take orders straight through WhatsApp and Instagram. Instead of being buried Instagram accounts, every maker lives on one platform, so buyers can browse them all in one place and order from a real page the maker owns.

records.name: TIQHire
records.tagline: Simplify the journey to your next great hire
records.description: TIQHire is an AI powered recruitment automation platform developed by TIQRI to simplify and improve the hiring process. It supports job creation, CV screening, AI-led interviews, candidate assessments, scoring, ranking, interview scheduling, notifications and feedback. Designed for businesses of different sizes, TIQHire helps recruiters save time, reduce hiring costs, improve candidate experiences and make more informed, data-driven recruitment decisions through one secure, centralised platform.

records.name: Brancho
records.tagline: Authentic mind mapping beyond boxes and straight lines
records.description: Brancho is a native mind mapping app for iPad and Mac. Instead of rigid boxes and straight lines, ideas grow from a central image through organic curved branches, colors, keywords, and images. Shape every branch, add detailed sticky notes, work quickly with keyboard controls, and preserve the thinking process with visual history and replay. Files can be saved locally or in iCloud Drive. Available in English and Japanese.

records.name: LeadRadar App —
records.tagline: Find B2B leads on Google Maps, reach out in one tap
records.description: LeadRadar App helps agencies and freelancers stop manually scrolling Google Maps for leads. Search any city and niche, filter by rating and website presence, then reach out via one-tap Call, WhatsApp, or SMS — no copy-pasting between tabs. Bring your own Google Maps API key, so you stay in full control of your search volume and costs. I built this because I needed it myself — I use it daily, searching hundreds of leads per session.

records.name: FE Guess: Fire Emblem Guessing Game
records.tagline: Guess today's Fire Emblem character
records.description: FE Guess is a free daily guessing game for Fire Emblem fans. Each day one mystery unit is drawn from thirty years of the series, from Shadow Dragon to Engage, and you identify it by comparing guesses across eight traits: debut game, starting class, weapon type, movement, sex, home realm, appearance count and race. Green means exact, amber means close, and arrows point higher or lower. There is no guess limit, so every round is pure deduction.

records.name: NOVRA
records.tagline: One Platform. One Brain. Unlimited Growth.
records.description: NOVRA is an AI platform built for modern businesses. Instead of isolated AI tools, NOVRA introduces the Company Brain—a centralized intelligence that powers every AI employee across chat, voice, email, and business integrations. Connect your knowledge, automate workflows, and let AI make consistent, policy-driven decisions while keeping humans in control of critical tasks. One Platform. One Brain. Unlimited Growth.

records.name: NovumOS
records.tagline: Assign kanban cards to AI agents. An agent seat is $1
records.description: NovumOS is a kanban board where you assign cards to AI agents the same way you assign them to people. Connect Claude Code in one command. Agents pull work from a queue, do it, and log every step on the card, so you always know what they did. Set a spending cap per agent, and pause it with one click if it goes off the rails. Agents run on your own API keys. No credit meters or token markups. $1 per agent seat. Free for 5 people and 1 agent.

records.name: TabChart
records.tagline: A free, native TradingView alternative for Windows
records.description: TabChart is a free, native Windows crypto charting app — TradingView-powered charts with real-time data straight from 7 exchanges over WebSocket, no account or API keys. Multi-chart tabs and a built-in screener. A desktop alternative to TradingView.

records.name: SellerPilot AI
records.tagline: Prevent Shopify stockouts and cash leaks
records.description: SellerPilot is a read-only Shopify inventory and cash guardrail. It forecasts stockout dates, calculates MOQ-adjusted reorder quantities, estimates revenue at risk and cash trapped in slow inventory, and turns fulfillment and margin exceptions into a daily action brief. Add supplier lead time, safety stock, incoming inventory and unit cost per SKU. The live Agent explains authorized store data but cannot modify your shop or access customer identity fields.

records.name: Stripe-Free Next.js Starter
records.tagline: Skip Stripe KYC. Next.js 14 + Supabase + Gumroad boilerplate
records.description: Stop losing weeks to Stripe KYC and global VAT calculations. This boilerplate is built for solo devs who want to ship fast using Gumroad, without sacrificing database security. Features: • Next.js 14 App Router • Supabase SSR Auth & RLS • Strict Fail-Closed Webhooks (prevents spoofing) • Zero Tax Overhead (Gumroad handles VAT) • shadcn/ui Built by a CS student to save you 40+ hours of backend headaches.

records.name: FormTwin
records.tagline: The daily health app built around your 3D body twin
records.description: FormTwin is a daily health hub built around an interactive 3D body twin—tap any muscle to see how to train it, and after a workout the muscles you hit light up. It also does workout plans, nutrition and macro logging, and habits, with a Today tab that gives a morning recap of your whole day. Start a workout or log food from Control Center. Built entirely on iOS 26, it works without an account, and there are no ads and no third-party tracking—your data stays on your device.
